message:
Let me check the build environment more - look for the source tree and how the target is built. Let me check what's in the build environment's working directory.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'pwd; echo "==="; ls -la; echo "==="; find / -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "src*" 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "==="; env | grep -i "work\|src\|out\|target" | head -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
